visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a light blue knitted cardigan over a white top and beige pants, stands in an indoor studio. She holds an iPhone in her left hand, displaying its control center. The background includes a wooden shelf with a plant and a framed picture on a textured wall. (2) Close-up screen recording of the iPhone interface. A finger taps the '+' icon in the top left, and then the screen scrolls down through various control icons like flashlight and screen recording to find the 'Ambient Music' section. (3) The screen displays four colorful tiles for different types of ambient music: 'Sleep', 'Leisure', 'Productivity', and 'Balance'. (4) The scene shifts to the woman lying on a bed with a green pillow and white blanket, eyes closed as if sleeping. A semi-transparent white overlay with a moon icon and 'Sleep' text appears. (5) The scene transitions to a sunny beach with clear blue water and tropical trees. The camera is static. A white overlay with a sun icon and 'Leisure' text appears in the center. (6) The scene shifts to the woman sitting at a desk in an office, typing on a laptop. Her hands move rapidly across the keyboard. A white overlay with a clipboard icon and 'Productivity' text is visible. (7) The woman is sitting cross-legged in a meditative pose on a light-colored rug in a living room. She has her hands on her knees, eyes closed. A white overlay with a heart icon and 'Balance' text appears. (8) Screen recording showing the sub-menu of the 'Sleep' music category, listing several tracks like 'Sleep Atmosphere' and 'Soothing Sound'. (9) The woman returns to the studio setting, holding the phone and pointing at it while speaking directly to the camera with an expressive face. (10) Screen recording of the iPhone's Clock app. A timer is set for 10 seconds, and the user scrolls through the 'When Timer Ends' options to select 'Stop Playing'. (11) The woman stands in the studio again, smiling widely and moving the phone toward the camera lens in a playful gesture.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to teach iPhone users how to access and utilize a hidden iOS feature—built-in ambient background music—for various lifestyle scenarios like sleeping, working, or meditating. It further provides a practical tip on using the system timer to automatically stop the music, enhancing user experience and productivity.
